answer: The timber cap is enforced at intake and jetty shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a farm in one epoch however much capital it holds, because each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a lotus tag. The deposit is 35 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
